polyline.data-label: InitializeSlot: overwrites UI & Unit arrays [COMPETING AUTHORITY]
Awake: factory creates premature stack then overwritten by UnitInventory

g.data-label: InitializeSlot: overwrites UI & Unit arrays [COMPETING AUTHORITY]
Awake: factory creates premature stack then overwritten by UnitInventory
ItemData (ScriptableObject) - displayName, itemName, type - maxStackSize, isStackable, Icon - oldSlot, newSlot (leaked runtime refs)
Storage (abstract MonoBehaviour) - items: Dictionary<ItemData, int> - capacityLimit: int? (treated as TOTAL UNITS)
UnitStorage (MonoBehaviour) - occupiedSlots: Dict<ItemType, int> - capacityLimit = 6 (SLOT COUNT != UNITS) - FullStacks, StackSize, slots (dead state)
BaseStorage (MonoBehaviour) - Player base economy storage - baseCapacity + structure bonus

UnitStorageManager (MonoBehaviour) - new storage: Storage (HIDES BASE FIELD) - unitStorage: UnitStorage (new UnitStorage() bug) - totalStacks: int (tracks item quantity) - usedSlots: Dict<ItemType, int> - NORMAL_SLOTS=4, CONSUME_SLOT=1
ItemSlot (MonoBehaviour on Unit GO) - itemStack: ItemStack - unitInventory: UnitInventory - storageManager: UnitStorageManager - restrictedType: ItemType?
ItemStack (MonoBehaviour on Unit GO) - itemData: ItemData - quantity: int - maxQuantity: int - itemSlot: ItemSlot (NEVER SET) - itemIcon, itemQuantityText (UI components)
Item (MonoBehaviour on Unit GO) - ID: Guid, itemData: ItemData - Refine(), Craft(), Consume()
InventoryUserface (abstract MonoBehaviour) - inventorySlots: List<ItemSlot> - RefreshInventoryDisplay(), ClearSlots()
ItemSlot (MonoBehaviour on Canvas Prefab) - button: Button - IDropHandler, IPointerEnterHandler - unitInventoryUI, unitInventory
ItemStack (MonoBehaviour on Canvas Prefab) - itemIcon: Image, itemQuantityText: Text - itemDragHandler: ItemDragHandler - IDropHandler, IPointerEnterHandler
ItemDragHandler (MonoBehaviour) - IBeginDragHandler, IDragHandler, IEndDragHandler - canvasGroup: CanvasGroup, canvas: Canvas
